entries.title: Master Battlefield Vertical Slice

entries.title: Canon Roster and Player Onboarding Redesign

entries.title: Solo Enemy Scaling and Raid Design

entries.title: Solo Titan Combat Redesign Baseline
entries.summary: Added the required Solo Titan Migration Report, Solo Combat Design Document, and full 63-Titan roster redesign; updated Titan, progression, campaign, and async arena records for one active Titan combat.

Added playable campaign selection flow: seven faction campaign cards, chapter browsing, Normal/Elite mission lists, mission detail pages, and data-driven launch into the battle shell using real mission objectives and threats.

Expanded mission and campaign architecture to all remaining factions: Olympian, Kami, Tuatha, Empyrean, and Infernal Dominion now each have 20 Normal and 20 Elite missions with matching chapter registry, dialogue, art packages, storyline arcs, and consequences.

Ran a full lore, story, mission, campaign, stat, and balance pass; added a reusable continuity/balance audit report; patched obsolete three-Titan mission wording and missing Aten Ra Normal turn limits; verified faction stat budget spread is clean.

Surfaced the latest Titan Gates Mini App export in the GitHub index so the public page shows the playable campaign shell, faction copy-paste canon packs, Codex copy buttons, Art Needs, simulator, and validation tools.

Expanded the first playable mission from a kill-all Gate seal into a multi-objective tactical encounter with Solar Seal stabilization, Hollow Anchor destruction, reinforcements, evacuation, turn pressure, and star scoring.
Enforced dashboard index freshness with SHA-256 source fingerprints and GitHub sync checks so data/index.json updates with every dashboard data change.
Added the Hollow as a usable non-playable threat faction with encounter pools and expanded creature roster for campaigns, missions, events, raids, and Ascension.
Added canon backstories for all Titans, NPCs, and creatures, tied to factions, lore, storyline arcs, and readable dashboard character pages.
Added the Storm-Oath Covenant Asgardian storyline campaign with 5 chapters, 20 Normal missions, 20 Elite remixes, dialogue, art packages, and consequence hooks.
Rewrote Map Art prompts so terrain effects appear as natural lore-built battleground features instead of glowing game tiles.
Hardened Art Prompt copy buttons for mobile GitHub Pages use, including larger touch controls and clipboard fallback behavior.
Added Art Import Queue so generated art can be attached to the correct prompt/entity, saved locally for review, and exported as artwork metadata.
Surfaced Art Map prompts in the generated index and Dev Dashboard, with clickable prompt cards that copy prompts directly to clipboard.
